articles.title: CDW tops quarterly estimates on steady demand from healthcare, government customers
articles.description: CDW beat Wall Street estimates for second-quarter results on Wednesday, helped by continued demand for IT solutions from its healthcare and government customers. The increasing need for hybrid data centers by combining cloud and on-premise infrastructure, has created new growth opportunities for CDW. CDW provides information technology solutions such as security, cloud, hybrid infrastructure to business, government, education and healthcare customers in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada.
